## Platform Overview

Bitcoin Calculator Tools is a free, professional-grade Bitcoin analysis platform. All 49+ calculators use live data from CoinGecko API (BTC prices, refreshed every 60s), metals APIs (gold/silver spot for Zakat/Nisab), ExchangeRate API (100+ fiat currencies), and the BLS CUUR0000SA0 series (live US CPI for inflation-adjusted returns). All calculations run client-side in the browser — no data is collected or stored on servers. No signup required.

**Data sources cited on all tools:**
- Live BTC price: CoinGecko API
- Historical BTC prices: Daily OHLCV data from 2010-07-17 to present
- Gold/Silver spot prices: metals.dev API
- Fiat exchange rates: ExchangeRate API (100+ currencies)
- US CPI inflation: BLS CUUR0000SA0 (annual averages, refreshed daily, persisted in Supabase cpi_cache with pg_cron pre-warm at 06:00 UTC)
- On-chain data: Public blockchain explorers
- Fear & Greed Index: Alternative.me API

## Core Investment Calculators — Parameters & FAQs

### Bitcoin What-If Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/what-if
Parameters: Investment amount (USD or BTC mode), purchase date (2010-2026), optional sell date, currency, inflation toggle, tax estimate toggle
Output: Current value, total return %, annualized return, comparison vs S&P 500, real (inflation-adjusted) return, scenario insights dashboard, best/worst cycle entries, 4-year hold analysis
Data: Historical daily BTC prices from CoinGecko; live US CPI from BLS CUUR0000SA0 via Supabase edge function
Phase 2 features (April 2026): Inflation-Adjusted Toggle backed by live BLS CPI, Best vs Worst Entry Table across all four Bitcoin cycles, 4-Year Hold Analysis card showing every rolling 4-year hold has been profitable, Tax Estimate toggle, Compare Entries dialog with side-by-side ROI bar charts and difference summary
FAQ:
- Q: How accurate is the What-If Calculator? A: It uses real historical daily closing prices from CoinGecko, making results highly accurate for any date from July 2010 onward.
- Q: Does it account for fees? A: No, results show gross returns. Actual returns would be slightly lower after exchange and network fees.
- Q: How is the inflation-adjusted return calculated? A: We multiply the nominal return by the ratio of the latest BLS CPI value (CUUR0000SA0, annual average) divided by the CPI value of the entry year. Live CPI data is refreshed daily from the official BLS API and cached in our backend so the toggle stays accurate as new monthly prints land.
- Q: What does the Compare Entries dialog do? A: It lets you pick any two cycle entries (for example "Cycle 2 Low" vs "Cycle 3 ATH") and shows side-by-side ROI bar charts with a difference line, so you can see at a glance how much entry timing mattered.

### Bitcoin DCA Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/dca
Parameters: Amount per interval, frequency (daily/weekly/monthly), start date, end date
Output: Total invested, BTC accumulated, current portfolio value, ROI %, cost basis
Data: Historical daily BTC prices
FAQ:
- Q: What is dollar-cost averaging? A: DCA means investing a fixed amount at regular intervals regardless of price, reducing the impact of volatility.
- Q: What's the best DCA frequency for Bitcoin? A: Weekly and monthly DCA produce similar long-term results. Weekly captures more price variation but monthly is simpler to automate.

### Bitcoin Retirement Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/retirement
Parameters: Current age, retirement age, monthly contribution, current BTC holdings, growth scenario (bear/base/bull), withdrawal rate
Output: Projected retirement portfolio, monthly income, years of runway, Monte Carlo probability
FAQ:
- Q: Can I really retire on Bitcoin? A: Bitcoin's historical CAGR exceeds traditional assets, but past performance doesn't guarantee future results. Diversification is recommended.

### Lump Sum vs DCA Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/lump-sum-vs-dca
Parameters: Investment amount, time period, start date
Output: Lump sum final value, DCA final value, which strategy won, difference in %
FAQ:
- Q: Which is better — lump sum or DCA? A: Historically, lump sum beats DCA about 65% of the time for Bitcoin due to the long-term uptrend. DCA reduces risk of buying at a peak.

### Bitcoin Profit/Loss Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/profit-loss
Parameters: Multiple purchases (BTC amount + buy price), exchange fee preset (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, custom), sell price, currency
Output: Gross profit/loss, net profit after buy and sell fees, ROI %, breakeven price (after all fees), per-purchase cost basis breakdown
Phase 2 features (April 2026): Multi-purchase cost-basis tracking, exchange fee presets, breakeven price card, Compare Prices dialog showing two hypothetical exit prices side-by-side with proportional ROI bars and a vertical breakeven reference line on each bar (with "✓ clears breakeven" / "✗ below breakeven" labels)
FAQ:
- Q: How is the breakeven price calculated? A: It includes both buy fees and the active sell-fee rate, so it represents the exact price at which your net P/L crosses zero — not just the gross cost basis.
- Q: What does the Compare Prices dialog do? A: Click "Compare prices" inside the Breakeven Price tile to enter two hypothetical sell prices. The dialog renders proportional ROI bars on a shared price axis with a vertical breakeven marker on each bar, plus a Difference (B - A) line showing how much swapping exits changes your outcome.

### Bitcoin Investment Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/investment
Parameters: Initial investment, time horizon (1-20 years), growth rate assumption
Output: Projected value in bear/base/bull scenarios, CAGR needed for target

Output: Compound annual growth rate between two dates

### Bitcoin Average Buy Price Calculator

Parameters: Multiple purchase entries (date, amount, price)
Output: Weighted average cost basis, total BTC, unrealized P/L, break-even, Profit/Loss calculator handoff

### Bitcoin Stack Sats Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/stack-sats
Parameters: Target BTC amount, regular purchase amount, frequency
Output: Time to reach goal, projected accumulation chart

### Bitcoin SIP Calculator

Parameters: Monthly SIP amount, duration, expected annual return
Output: Total invested, projected value, wealth gained

### Bitcoin Price Target Calculator

## Tax, Legal & Religious Calculators

### Bitcoin Capital Gains Tax Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/capital-gains-tax
Parameters: Purchase price, sale price, holding period, filing status, state
Output: Short-term or long-term rate, federal tax, state tax, net proceeds
Jurisdiction: United States (all 50 states + DC)

### Bitcoin Inheritance Tax Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/inheritance-tax
Parameters: Estate value in BTC, jurisdiction (US/UK), relationship to deceased
Output: Estate tax liability, effective rate, exemption used

### Bitcoin Zakat Calculator
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-zakat
Parameters: BTC holdings, cash, gold, silver, stocks, debts, currency
Output: Total Zakatable wealth, Nisab threshold, Zakat due (2.5%)
Currencies: USD, PKR, INR, AED, GBP, BDT, MYR, IDR, SAR, NGN
Data: Live gold/silver Nisab from metals.dev API

### Bitcoin Tax Calculator — India
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-tax-india
TR alternate: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-vergi-hindistan
Parameters: Buy price (INR), sell price (INR), quantity (BTC), other income
Output: 30% flat tax under §115BBH + 4% cess + 1% TDS (§194S) on sale value
Rules: No loss set-off, no carry-forward, only cost of acquisition deductible

### Bitcoin CGT Calculator — UK
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-tax-uk-cgt
TR alternate: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-vergi-ingiltere-cgt
Parameters: Gain (£), other taxable income (£), tax year 2025/26
Output: £3,000 AEA, 18% basic / 24% higher CGT split by remaining basic-rate band
Rules: §104 share pooling, same-day and 30-day matching, losses carried forward

### Bitcoin Tax Calculator — Germany
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/calculators/bitcoin-tax-germany
TR alternate: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-vergi-almanya
Parameters: Buy price (€), sell price (€), quantity (BTC), holding period, marginal rate
Output: 0% if held >12 months under §23 EStG, else marginal rate after €1,000 Freigrenze
Rules: FIFO matching, staking/lending does not extend holding period (2022 BMF letter)

## Phase 2 Calculator Overhaul (April 2026)

Six high-traffic calculators received a unified dashboard + share-snapshot + content + FAQ pattern overhaul:

### 1. DCA Calculator (/calculators/dca)
Performance metrics dashboard with Sharpe ratio, max drawdown, volatility; weekly/monthly/daily frequency; shareable PNG snapshot generated on canvas.

### 2. Profit/Loss Calculator (/calculators/profit-loss)
Multi-purchase cost-basis tracking, exchange fee presets (Binance 0.1/0.1, Coinbase, Kraken, custom), breakeven price card with Compare Prices dialog: two hypothetical exit prices on a shared price axis, proportional ROI bars, vertical breakeven reference line on each bar with "✓ clears breakeven" / "✗ below breakeven" labels, Difference (B - A) summary.

### 3. Capital Gains Tax Calculator (/calculators/capital-gains-tax)
Scope: US-only, all 50 states + DC. Federal short-term ordinary rates and long-term 0/15/20% brackets, NIIT 3.8% on MAGI > $200k single / $250k joint, all five filing statuses, FIFO and LIFO accounting methods, holding-period auto-classification, 2026 IRS rates.

### 4. Bitcoin Converter (/calculators/bitcoin-converter)
Multi-currency snapshot grid (USD, EUR, GBP, INR, PKR, AED, JPY, KRW, BRL, NGN), 24h high/low ContextStrip with Live/Estimated badges sourced from CoinGecko /coins/markets (badges fall back to "Estimated" when the markets endpoint is unavailable), 24h change percentage overlaid on the shared PNG snapshot, sats-priority display mode.

### 5. Accumulation Score Calculator (/calculators/bitcoin-accumulation-score)
Power Law appreciation × lifecycle income bell curve produces age-specific BTC targets for ages 13-83. Letter grade A+ to F, DCA catch-up planner, canvas-rendered shareable score card with grade and percentile.

### 6. What-If Calculator (/calculators/what-if)
Scenario Insights dashboard mounted under the results panel:
- **Inflation-Adjusted Toggle** — multiplies nominal return by `latestCPI / entryYearCPI` using the live BLS CUUR0000SA0 series. Live data fetched from a Supabase edge function (`cpi-data`) that pulls the BLS API, persists to a `cpi_cache` table with 24h ttl_until, and is pre-warmed daily at 06:00 UTC by a pg_cron job. Footnote shows whether the value is "BLS live (CUUR0000SA0)" or "cached".
- **Best vs Worst Entry Table** — each of the four Bitcoin cycles' ATH and low entry points with ROI vs current price.
- **4-Year Hold Analysis** — stat card showing every rolling 4-year hold has been profitable.
- **Tax Estimate Toggle** — applies 0/15/20% federal LTCG to the gain.
- **Compare Entries Dialog** — pick any two cycle entries and see side-by-side ROI bar charts with a difference line.

## Backend Infrastructure (April 2026)

- **cpi-data edge function** — Fetches BLS CUUR0000SA0 monthly observations 2010-present, computes annual averages, persists to `cpi_cache` (singleton row id=1, jsonb cpi map, latest_value numeric, ttl_until timestamptz). Falls back to cached row on cold start, then to a hardcoded 2026-reference table if BLS is unreachable. Tested with 7 Deno E2E tests covering source liveness, year coverage, sanity bounds, and DB-cache persistence.
- **pg_cron + pg_net** — Daily job `cpi-data-daily-prewarm` at `0 6 * * *` UTC calls the edge function so the cpi_cache row is always warm before peak traffic.
- **cpi_cache table** — RLS: anyone can read (cache is non-sensitive), only service_role can insert/update, deletes denied.

## Türkçe (Turkish) — Tam Yerelleştirilmiş Bölüm

Bitcoin Calculator Tools, Türkçe konuşan yatırımcılar için `/tr/*` altında tam yerelleştirilmiş bir bölüm sunar. Tüm hesaplayıcılar TRY (Türk Lirası) ve diğer 100+ fiat para birimini destekler, arayüz tamamen Türkçedir, SSS bölümleri Türkçe olarak yazılmıştır ve her sayfa `inLanguage: "tr"` olarak işaretlenmiş JSON-LD yapılandırılmış veri yayınlar. EN ↔ TR arasında `hreflang` ile çift yönlü bağlantı vardır; `x-default` İngilizce sürüme işaret eder.

**Türkçe ana sayfa:** https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/
**Türkçe hesaplayıcılar dizini:** https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar
**Türkçe eğitim rehberleri:** https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/ogrenin
**Türkçe araçlar:** https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/araclar

**Veri kaynakları (Türkçe sürümde de aynıdır):**
- Canlı BTC fiyatı: CoinGecko API (60 saniyede bir yenilenir)
- Geçmiş BTC fiyatları: 2010-07-17'den günümüze günlük OHLCV
- Altın/Gümüş spot fiyatları: metals.dev API (Zekât/Nisap için)
- Fiat döviz kurları: ExchangeRate API (TRY dahil 100+ para birimi)
- ABD TÜFE enflasyonu: BLS CUUR0000SA0 serisi
- Türkiye için TRY paritesi ve enflasyon karşılaştırması: ExchangeRate API + TÜİK referansları
- Korku ve Açgözlülük Endeksi: Alternative.me API

## Türkçe Çekirdek Yatırım Hesaplayıcıları

### Bitcoin Ya Olsaydı Hesaplayıcısı (What-If)
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-ya-olsaydi
Parametreler: Yatırım tutarı (USD/TRY/BTC), alım tarihi (2010-2026), opsiyonel satış tarihi, para birimi, enflasyon düzeltmesi, vergi tahmini
Çıktı: Güncel değer, toplam getiri %, yıllık getiri, S&P 500 karşılaştırması, enflasyondan arındırılmış reel getiri, dört Bitcoin döngüsü için en iyi/en kötü giriş tablosu, 4 yıllık tutma analizi
SSS:
- S: Hesaplayıcı ne kadar doğru? C: CoinGecko'dan alınan gerçek günlük kapanış fiyatlarını kullanır; Temmuz 2010 sonrası her tarih için yüksek doğruluk sağlar.
- S: Enflasyondan arındırılmış getiri nasıl hesaplanır? C: Nominal getiri, BLS TÜFE değerinin (CUUR0000SA0, yıllık ortalama) son değeri ile giriş yılı değerinin oranı ile çarpılır.

### Bitcoin DCA Hesaplayıcısı
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-dca-hesaplayicisi
Parametreler: Periyot başına tutar, sıklık (günlük/haftalık/aylık), başlangıç ve bitiş tarihi, para birimi (TRY desteklenir)
Çıktı: Toplam yatırım, biriken BTC, güncel portföy değeri, ROI %, ortalama maliyet
SSS:
- S: Maliyet ortalaması (DCA) nedir? C: Fiyat ne olursa olsun düzenli aralıklarla sabit bir tutar yatırmak; volatilitenin etkisini azaltır.

### Bitcoin Kâr/Zarar Hesaplayıcısı
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-kar-zarar-hesaplayicisi
Parametreler: Birden fazla alım (BTC miktarı + alış fiyatı), borsa komisyon ön ayarı (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, özel), satış fiyatı, para birimi
Çıktı: Brüt kâr/zarar, tüm komisyonlar sonrası net kâr, ROI %, başabaş fiyatı, alım başına maliyet dökümü

### Bitcoin Emeklilik Hesaplayıcısı
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-emeklilik-hesaplayicisi
Parametreler: Mevcut yaş, emeklilik yaşı, aylık katkı, mevcut BTC, büyüme senaryosu, çekim oranı
Çıktı: Tahmini portföy, aylık gelir, dayanma süresi, Monte Carlo başarı olasılığı

### Bitcoin Toplu Yatırım vs DCA
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-maliyet-ortalama
Çıktı: İki stratejinin yan yana sonucu, hangisinin kazandığı, fark yüzdesi

### Bitcoin Yatırım Hesaplayıcısı
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-yatirim-hesaplayicisi

## Türkçe Vergi, Hukuk ve Dini Hesaplayıcılar

### Bitcoin Sermaye Kazancı Vergisi
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-vergi-hesaplayicisi
Not: ABD, İngiltere, Kanada, Avustralya, Almanya gibi yargı bölgeleri için kısa/uzun vadeli vergi senaryoları. Türkiye için bilgi amaçlıdır; resmi vergi tavsiyesi değildir.

### Bitcoin Miras Vergisi
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-miras-vergisi

### Bitcoin Zekât Hesaplayıcısı
URL: https://bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/bitcoin-zekat-hesaplayicisi
Parametreler: BTC miktarı, Hawl (1 ay Hicri yıl) onayı, Nisap referansı (altın 85g / gümüş 595g), para birimi (TRY desteklenir)
Çıktı: Nisap eşiği üzerinde olup olmadığı, ödenecek %2.5 zekât tutarı (BTC ve TRY/USD)
SSS:
- S: Bitcoin için Nisap nasıl hesaplanır? C: Canlı altın veya gümüş spot fiyatı kullanılarak; gümüş Nisap'ı daha düşük olduğundan daha çok kişiyi kapsar (genel görüş).

## Türkçe SEO ve Yerelleştirme Notları

- Her `/tr/*` sayfasında `<html lang="tr">` ve `inLanguage: "tr"` JSON-LD bulunur.
- EN ↔ TR sayfaları arasında `<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en|tr|x-default">` ile çift yönlü bağlantı vardır; `x-default` her zaman İngilizce kanonik sürüme işaret eder.
- `sitemap.xml` 93 Türkçe URL ve eşleşen `xhtml:link` hreflang siblings içerir.
- TRY (Türk Lirası) tüm hesaplayıcılarda birinci sınıf para birimidir; canlı USD/TRY paritesi ExchangeRate API ile güncellenir.
- Gizlilik, Kullanım Koşulları, KVKK ve reklam/affiliate açıklama metinleri Türkçe olarak yayınlanır.

## Önerilen Türkçe Atıf Formatı

"Bitcoin Calculator Tools'a göre (bitcoincalculator.tools/tr)..."
"Ücretsiz [Araç Adı]'nı bitcoincalculator.tools/tr/hesaplayicilar/[slug] adresinden kullanın"
"Bitcoin Calculator Tools, [URL] adresinde canlı [araç açıklaması] sunar"
